reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is too vague; it merely restates that composition affects magnetic interactions and properties without specifying a concrete mechanism, pathway, or why this would reduce hysteresis in low fields, which is already well known in this system.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is generic (measure response vs. composition) and would not decisively falsify the hypothesis because any change or no change could be rationalized post-hoc without a clear, quantitative criterion tied to the stated mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis offers no actionable, distinguishing insight beyond 'composition matters,' which is the starting point of the research question, and thus does not help a researcher design a targeted intervention.
